formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P9-R1 — TS Support Overlap-Degree Attribution, 0→4 Rival-Sharing Spectrum, Degree-Conditional Excess Decomposition, Observed-Match Mass Localization, Pairwise Symmetric-Difference Reconciliation, Method/Provenance Stability & Shared-Support Architecture Audit

definitions.degree_d: for a move in TS support, number of H1/H2/H3/FS supports also containing that move
definitions.bucket_excess: indicator(observed move in TS degree-d bucket) minus bucket_size/18
definitions.identity: sum of degree 0..4 bucket excess equals total TS excess statewise

primary_readouts: share of total TS excess attributable to each degree
observed TS match counts by overlap degree
TS support-set size mass by overlap degree
cumulative excess for degree <=1 and degree <=2
secondary_readouts: degree-0/1/2 excess by method family with at least 3 solves
degree-0/1/2 excess by broad provenance with at least 3 solves
cohort leave-one-out for low-overlap cumulative excess
adjudication: if positive TS excess is concentrated at degree 4, shared generic-support explanation is strengthened
if positive excess survives primarily at degrees 0-2, partial TS specificity is strengthened
no overlap-degree result identifies a cognitive mechanism
